description: Live Texas (ERCOT) grid status from ERCOT's public dashboards: frequency, demand, net load, capacity and reserve margin (MW and %), wind, solar and inertia; the latest generation mix by fuel with shares; real-time and day-ahead prices for ERCOT hubs and load zones (USD/MWh); and ERCOT's demand and capacity forecast for the coming hours. Choose this tool for: Live Texas grid status from ERCOT's public dashboards. Close alternatives on this server: energy_american_carbon_registry (American Carbon Registry projects from its public registry); energy_biofuel_rin_credits_epa (US EPA Renewable Fuel Standard RIN data from EPA's public). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: energy_ercot_texas_grid_status
title: Live Texas grid status from ERCOT's public dashboards
